about: A fast terminal viewer for Excel files, with search, formulas and export to CSV and JSON.

prs.title: Cells holding only a time now show just the time
prs.broken: A cell with only a time, such as a shift start at 09:30, showed as 1899-12-31 09:30:00 in the table and in CSV and JSON exports.
prs.changed: Times without a date now show as 09:30:00, and dates and date-times are unchanged.
prs.matters: Timesheets and schedules read and export the way they look in Excel.
